scope.extraction_location: temporary directory; not committed or published
scope.visual_method: Human review of contact sheets containing every source image, with filenames. Each thumbnail was approximately 112 by 112 pixels.

dataset_bias_observations: Background appearance varies substantially by class. Kachki images include both vivid cyan backgrounds and mottled gray-blue surfaces; Tengra images predominantly use a mottled gray-blue surface. Several other classes predominantly use vivid cyan or blue backgrounds.
Fish size, framing, and camera angle also vary across classes. These correlations can let a classifier predict class from capture setup or background rather than fish features.

educational_use.recommended_activity: Compare a normal classifier with an experiment that crops or masks the fish, then inspect how accuracy and errors change.
limitations: A full-resolution, image-by-image rights review was not performed; contact-sheet review can miss small details.
The visual review does not establish permission for any third-party rights that may attach to the photographs.
The dataset license and authorship/authority to license all image content still require documented sign-off before redistribution.
Near-duplicate and same-capture relationships were not exhaustively assessed.

publication_decision.reason: The visual and metadata triage found no people, readable text, logos, watermarks, or embedded EXIF/XMP/IPTC/comment metadata, but it does not resolve all third-party rights or document final redistribution approval.
